data.title: Verde
data.about:
One of Dubai’s most desirable communities, Jumeirah Lakes Towers, provides a new way to live. This region is bordered by tranquil lakes, thriving residential complexes, bustling major roadways, and more. 

Sobha Verde, with 66 stories and stunning views of the lush green meadows and emerald golf course, is one of the tallest residential towers. Select from magnificent one- to three-bedroom apartments that exude magnificence. The ultra-luxurious homes are built with the highest-quality amenities to appeal to the discriminating tastes of globetrotters. Verde is only three minutes away from Sheikh Zayed Road, which connects you to all of Dubai’s major attractions.
